paper_title: New ALPS Results on Hidden-Sector Lightweights
notes: LSW experiment (light-shining-through-wall) at DESY using HERA dipole magnet. Constrains ALP-photon coupling g_- (pseudoscalar) and g_+ (scalar) vs ALP mass, kinetic mixing chi for hidden photons, and minicharged particle charge Q. Pre-analysis hint AxionPhoton is correct for the primary ALP result (Fig 4). Data points are approximate estimates read from the exclusion plot (Fig 4, y-axis 1e-7 to 1e-6 GeV^-1, x-axis 1e-4 to 1e-3 eV) since no numerical table of coupling limits is given (Table 1 gives only conversion probabilities ~1e-25). The paper also constrains DarkPhoton (chi vs m_gamma', Fig 5) and minicharged particles; those were not extracted. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density.
